Q: How should I prepare for a General Medicine appointment? A: Please bring photo ID, previous prescriptions, and recent test reports. Also bring a record of your temperature readings.

Q: How should I prepare for a Cardiology appointment? A: Please bring photo ID, previous prescriptions, and recent test reports. Also bring any previous ECG reports and a list of your blood pressure readings.
Q: How should I prepare for a Pulmonology appointment? A: Please bring photo ID, previous prescriptions, and recent test reports. Also bring your inhalers so the doctor can check your technique.
Q: How should I prepare for a Gastroenterology appointment? A: Please bring photo ID, previous prescriptions, and recent test reports. Also note what you ate in the days before your symptoms started.
Q: How should I prepare for an Endocrinology appointment? A: Please bring photo ID, previous prescriptions, and recent test reports. Also bring your home blood sugar records.

Q: How should I prepare for a Dermatology appointment? A: Please bring photo ID, previous prescriptions, and recent test reports. Also do not apply creams to the affected skin on the day of the visit.
Q: How should I prepare for an Orthopedics appointment? A: Please bring photo ID, previous prescriptions, and recent test reports. Also wear loose clothing and bring any previous X-rays.
Q: How should I prepare for a Neurology appointment? A: Please bring photo ID, previous prescriptions, and recent test reports. Also bring a headache or symptom diary.
Q: How should I prepare for an ENT appointment? A: Please bring photo ID, previous prescriptions, and recent test reports. Also note when your symptoms started and what makes them worse.
Q: How should I prepare for an Ophthalmology appointment? A: Please bring photo ID, previous prescriptions, and recent test reports. Also bring your current glasses.
Q: How should I prepare for an Obstetrics and Gynecology appointment? A: Please bring photo ID, previous prescriptions, and recent test reports. Also note the date of your last period.
Q: How should I prepare for a Psychiatry appointment? A: Please bring photo ID, previous prescriptions, and recent test reports. Also note your main worries and your sleep pattern for one week.
